core_obligations: Set up the local problem (proof lines 5800-5812): given an etale U over X and a point u, the author works with the image of u in X and uses local quasi-finiteness to isolate u in its fibre.

Construct the base change (proof lines 5812-5840): by separation and local quasi-finiteness the author finds an etale neighbourhood V of the image of u in Y such that the base change X x_Y V decomposes as a disjoint union of an open piece containing u and its complement, with a morphism from the open piece to U.
Conclude property (A) (proof lines 5840-5849): the construction is exactly the condition of property (A), so the morphism has the property.
proof_roadmap: Isolate the point in its fibre using local quasi-finiteness.
Use separation to spread the isolation out over an etale neighbourhood of the base.
Obtain the disjoint union decomposition required by property (A).
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies property (A) for a separated locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes (statement lines 5794-5798, with property (A) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof isolates the given point in its fibre using local quasi-finiteness (proof lines 5800-5812), then uses separation to find an etale neighbourhood of the base over which the base change splits off a piece containing the point together with a morphism to the given etale U (proof lines 5812-5840), which is precisely the condition of property (A) (proof lines 5840-5849). The non-formal content is the use of separation to make the isolation uniform over the base. The claim is H2: one geometric construction, written out.
